source: Adapted cross-reference, September 2026: Wikipedia's edition summary of headliners 1998 to 2022, 2025 and 2026 line-up reporting (Ticketmaster Discover, Skiddle, Electronic Groove, the official 2025 history page, the festival's own YouTube titles), NME for the 2012 bill. This site's catalogue (source 6 of FIGURES.md) holds 52 Creamfields sets, 51 from Beatport and 1 from Mixmag, none by the drum and bass acts the page names; the players come from the festival's own channel (Creamfields Official Page), oEmbed-checked 13 September 2026.
